name: Suno
good_for: It turns a few words about a style or theme into a full song with music and singing.
watch_out: Songs made on the free plan cannot be used for business or sold.

name: Runway
good_for: It turns your words or photos into short video clips for ads, social posts, or creative projects.
watch_out: You spend credits for each second of video, so longer videos use them up fast.

name: Kimi
good_for: A free chatbot that handles very long documents and searches the web, with open models you can also run yourself.
watch_out: It is made by a Chinese company, so think carefully about what personal details you share.

name: MindStudio
good_for: Build and run your own AI agents, with 200+ AI models available through MindStudio so you do not need your own API keys.
watch_out: The pricing page no longer lists a free plan. The Individual plan has unlimited agents and runs for $20/month on monthly billing ($16/month if you pay yearly), and AI model usage is charged on top. The page now puts a newer product called Remy first ($99/month after a 30-day free trial) and calls the Individual plan one of its "legacy MindStudio plans".

name: Wondercraft
good_for: An AI video studio that brings AI video, avatar, image, voice and sound tools together in guided steps for making business-ready videos. No credit card is needed to start.
watch_out: The free plan gives 150 credits, limited access to the AI models and exports up to 720p. No watermark and full commercial rights start with Creator at $25/month on monthly billing, which includes 1,000 credits.

name: Hermes Agent
good_for: An open-source personal AI agent you install on a Mac, Windows or Linux computer and talk to from Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal or email. It remembers your projects, runs scheduled tasks and can browse the web.
watch_out: The free Nous Portal plan is pay-as-you-go and includes free AI models only, with no hosted tools. Access to 200+ models and hosted tools starts with the Plus plan at $20/month.

name: Rork
good_for: Describe the app you want and Rork designs it for you by chat. The free plan lets you explore app designs; turning a design into a working iPhone, Android or web app needs a paid plan.
watch_out: The free plan is design-only, with 35 design credits a month and at most 5 a day. Build mode, which turns designs into working apps, needs a paid plan: $20/month gives 100 credits a month and 1 free hour of simulators and Xcode builds, and $200/month gives 1,000 credits and 10 free hours.

name: OpenClaw
price_from: Free (no subscription and no paid hosted version)
good_for: An open-source AI assistant you run on your own Mac, Windows or Linux computer and message from WhatsApp, Telegram or other chat apps. It can organise your inbox, send emails and manage your calendar.
watch_out: You bring the AI model it uses (hosted, subscription-backed or local), and any model charges are separate. It acts for you on your own computer, so connect only the accounts you are happy for it to use.

name: Qwant
good_for: A French search engine hosted in Europe that says it does not store your search history. For some factual questions its AI shows a short Flash Answer with source links above the results.
watch_out: Qwant says it is free. The Flash Answer only appears for certain factual searches, not every search, and may not be switched on in every region or language yet. Qwant says the AI can be wrong, so check the sources it cites.

name: Reddit AI search
price_from: Free (Reddit Premium $5.99/month raises the daily limit)
good_for: Ask a question in plain words and get an AI summary of what people on Reddit say, with in-line links to the original posts and comments.
watch_out: Logged-out users can ask 10 questions a week and logged-in users 50 a day; Reddit Premium at $5.99/month allows 100 a day. It only draws on Reddit posts and comments, which Reddit says are not checked, so double-check anything important. It works in English anywhere, and in Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, French and German.

name: Cursor
good_for: It is an app where an AI assistant helps you write, fix, and explain code right in your editor.
watch_out: The free plan has limited AI use; the $8 Plus plan only works with Grok models, and other companies' models are billed extra on the Premium plan ($30 a month).

good_for: It turns spoken audio into written text, great for transcribing meetings, lectures, or video subtitles. It understands dozens of languages.
name: Whisper
watch_out: You have to install it yourself with some command-line steps, and it needs a decent computer to run well.

good_for: Google's top video maker; it turns words or photos into sharp, cinematic video clips, even with matching sound.
name: Veo
watch_out: The free plan gives you 50 Google Flow credits a day, and each video uses credits; the cheapest paid plan (Google AI Plus) costs $4.99 a month, and prices may vary by country.

good_for: It turns your words or photos into short, fun video clips with playful effects like melting or exploding objects.
name: Pika
watch_out: The free plan gives you no monthly credits, so you buy credit packs to make clips; the cheapest plan (Starter) costs $10 a month, or $8 if you pay for a year.

good_for: It turns words or photos into smooth, realistic-looking video clips, and the free Basic plan lets you try it.
name: Kling
watch_out: The free Basic plan has a watermark and no commercial use; paid plans start at $10 a month.

good_for: An AI software engineer that can plan, write, and test code for whole projects on its own in the cloud.
name: Devin
watch_out: The free plan only gives you a light quota; the $20 Pro plan has higher limits, and extra use is charged at API prices, so heavy use can cost more than $20.

good_for: It suggests code as you type right inside your editor, and it can explain code and help fix bugs.
name: GitHub Copilot
watch_out: The free plan only includes a limited number of completions and chats each month.

good_for: A smarter way to Google: it gives full AI answers with links, and you can ask follow-up questions.
name: Google AI Mode
watch_out: It is built into Google Search. You can use it without signing in, but you need to sign in and turn on history to pick up where you left off, and its answers can include mistakes.

good_for: A free AI chat assistant that is strong at math, coding, and careful step-by-step thinking.
name: DeepSeek
watch_out: Your chats are stored on servers in China, so do not share private details with it.

good_for: Great for making logos, posters, and designs that include words — it spells text inside pictures better than most other tools.
name: Ideogram
watch_out: Everything you make on the free plan is public. Paid plans and pay-as-you-go credits keep new pictures private until you publish them. Free accounts only get weekly credits if they sign in with Google, Apple or Microsoft, and the amount can change.
